purpose: Protect repeated city mentions across information and route clauses, and guarantee a weaveable local route fallback.

cases.input: Puoi parlarmi di Lecce e di cosa c'è da vedere e cosa c'è intorno poi mi fai un percorso tra Lecce Gallipoli Nardò e infine Otranto
parti da Lecce vai a Gallipoli poi Nardò e infine Otranto
expect: all four cities remain in the exact route sequence
exact routes are not capped by the generic maxStops value
if primary and fallback external routing fail, a local LineString is built from all route waypoints
the local fallback computes indicative distance and duration
lastRouteGeometryPoints is populated from the fallback geometry
pendingAracneMapWeave becomes true and the spider can weave the fallback route
